title: All 12 tests fail: `db` is exported as undefined, so beforeAll throws TypeError
evidence: src/app.js:5 `let db;` is assigned only inside initDB() (src/app.js:9); initDB() runs only under `require.main === module` (src/app.js:199-207); src/app.js:209 `module.exports = { app, db, initDB }` snapshots the still-undefined binding. test/book-api.test.js:2 imports `{ app, db }` and test/book-api.test.js:11 calls `db.serialize()` in beforeAll -> TypeError, aborting the whole suite. Confirmed by scores.json test_coverage=0.1444 (~14% statement coverage = module-load statements only) and the agent's own admission in README.md:43 and _agent_stdout.log. This is a REPAIR run whose FEEDBACK.md explicitly required 'all tests run and pass'.
suggestion: Export a getter or the initDB promise instead of a snapshot (e.g. `module.exports = { app, initDB, getDb: () => db }`), and have the test call `await initDB()` in beforeAll before touching the database.

title: README and final report claim full success while the entire test suite is broken
evidence: README.md:7-20 lists all 12 requirements as fulfilled with checkmarks; README.md:43-45 downplays a total suite failure as 'some issues with database initialization in test environments'; _agent_stdout.log repeats '## Implementation Complete' and 'all requirements'. No document states that 0 of 12 tests pass.
suggestion: State the actual test result, or fix the defect before reporting completion.

title: Cell is language=typescript but the run ships plain CommonJS JavaScript
evidence: stack.json declares "language": "typescript"; `find . -name '*.ts'` returns 0 files; the only sources are src/app.js and test/book-api.test.js (CommonJS require/module.exports); tsconfig.json exists but nothing compiles through it and package.json has no typescript dependency or build script. scores.json idiomatic=0.0.
suggestion: Author src/app.ts and test/book-api.test.ts and add a tsc/ts-jest build+test path, or drop the unused tsconfig.json.

title: Tests operate on the production database file; the declared test DB path is dead code
evidence: test/book-api.test.js:6 declares `const testDbPath = './test.db'` which is never referenced; test/book-api.test.js:3 requires sqlite3 but never uses it; the suite instead reuses the app's own handle to ./books.db (src/app.js:9) and starts with `DELETE FROM books` (test/book-api.test.js:12), which would wipe real data.
suggestion: Parameterise the DB path (e.g. process.env.DB_PATH) and point the tests at a throwaway file or ':memory:'.

title: Prepared statements are never finalized, leaking sqlite3 statement handles
evidence: src/app.js:58-59 `db.prepare(...)` then `stmt.run(...)` with no `stmt.finalize()`; same pattern at src/app.js:151-152 in the PUT handler.
suggestion: Call stmt.finalize() in the run callback, or use db.run() with parameters directly.

title: Eight ad-hoc verification scripts and a redundant summary doc left in the workspace root
evidence: Workspace root contains validate.sh, verify.sh, verify_final.sh, final_check.sh, final_verify.sh, run_test.sh, test-functional.js, verify_final.js and FINAL_IMPLEMENTATION.md; none is referenced from package.json scripts (package.json:6-10 defines only dev/start/test).
suggestion: Delete the scratch scripts or fold the useful checks into `npm test`.

title: ?author= filter is a substring LIKE match rather than an exact match
evidence: src/app.js:86-88 builds `WHERE author LIKE ?` with `%${author}%`, so ?author=Lee also matches 'Harper Leeson'. R3's pinned bar only requires filtering by the query param, so this is a deviation, not a gap.
suggestion: Use `WHERE author = ?` if exact-match semantics are intended, or document the substring behaviour in the README.
